title: R' Yose ben Perata (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Nedarim 41a; he spoke in the name of R' Eliezer. Perhaps the text should read "ben Perida," who was a student of R' Eliezer.[^1][^2]

notes.text: מא. gives Nedarim 41a under the period convention, without fresh edition verification.

ואולי retains perhaps: Hyman proposes Perida instead of Perata, grounded in the reported discipleship. דר״א is contextually Eliezer from the same sentence, but no full personal title is supplied; both Eliezer occurrences and Yose remain R'. Tanna is a source classification only. Inherited provisional heading and earlier audit פרמא versus supplied פרטא remain unadjudicated.
